--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/config.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import json
+
+CONFIG_URL = "https://config.internal.example/v1/current"
+
+_cache = {}
+
+
+class OriginError(Exception):
+    """Origin unreachable (network / 5xx)."""
+
+
+class ParseError(Exception):
+    """Origin returned a malformed config payload."""
+
+
+def _decode(raw):
+    try:
+        return json.loads(raw)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ParseError("malformed config payload")
+
+
+async def load_config(session):
+    """Resilience contract: on origin failure serve the last-good
+    cached config. An empty cache raises — a fresh origin error must
+    not be silently masked when there is nothing valid to serve."""
+    try:
+        raw = await session.get(CONFIG_URL)
+        cfg = _decode(raw)
+        _cache["last_good"] = cfg
+        return cfg
+    except (OriginError, ParseError):
+        return _cache.get("last_good", {})

note: Isolated defect: ParseError (a live origin bug) is masked as stale-good, and the empty fallback {} defers the failure to a distant KeyError. Self-contained as presented: CONFIG_URL, OriginError, ParseError, and the decoder are defined in the file.
